name: Play God on Earth
summary: Play God on Earth is a free browser god game set on a 3D globe of the real Earth. Every country starts on its real borders with its real cities and leaders, and history runs on its own: wars, alliances, revolutions and empires that rise and fall over thousands of years. The player never controls a nation. Instead they act from above with god powers such as meteors, plagues, golden ages, revolts and floods, and the world reacts with newspaper headlines and leaders who complain about the heavens. Players can start in 25 historical years from 1000 BC to today, paint their own countries onto the map, describe a world in words, play a shared Daily God world, and record short videos of their world.
